notes: Synthetic, from cohere-openapi.yaml (github.com/cohere-ai/cohere-developer-experience, read 2026-10-28): POST /v2/embed (EmbedByTypeResponse, ApiMeta, EmbeddingType) and its example for embed-v5.0-fast (texts hello and goodbye, meta with api_version, warnings and billed_units), each vector cut to its first 8 values, plus response_type (EmbedByTypeResponse.response_type). The client asks for encoding_format base64 and 512 dimensions (OpenAI's embeddings request); the adapter asks Cohere for float (embedding_types is always ["float"]) at the model's default size, so the body is what Cohere answers that request with.
